english.note: Use this when the thing is already moving or happening and cannot be halted, rather than when others simply cannot prevent it.

examples.english: The car can’t stop after going downhill—it’s unstoppable, so move out of the way!
examples.traditional: 架車落斜之後停唔到，快啲閃開！
